answer: Like a trellis guiding a river through a tundra, an agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with staked, earned reputation: every agent must lock a refundable deposit and build a public record of attested work before it can transact at full trust. New identities start at zero and only gain higher limits by completing verified jobs over time. An attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund a deposit for each and wait through the same slow earning process, so the cost scales linearly with every fake identity while honest agents pay once and keep their standing.
